name: ai-training-data-curator
title: AI Training Data Curator
description: Crawl public websites and export clean, structured text datasets for LLM fine-tuning, RAG, and machine learning. Extracts title, body text, metadata, filters by language and quality, deduplicates near-duplicates, and outputs JSONL/CSV via Apify dataset.
seoTitle: AI Training Data Curator — Web to LLM Dataset
seoDescription: Turn any public website into a clean training dataset for LLM fine-tuning and RAG. Crawl, extract, filter, deduplicate, and export structured JSON with url, title, text, language, and word count.
